topic: Reviewing facility and asset data discrepancies
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on reviewing data discrepancies related to facility and asset IDs. One participant noted that while changes were visible for one specific area (JCD_SP), they were not reflected in another (JCD_RIo). The discussion centered on verifying if the Frame ID was correctly assigned, specifically regarding assets for facilities without boxes. A review of the database and 'mods' confirmed data integrity from [me]'s perspective. Ultimately, it was determined that half of the installed screens might be missing from the sheet, requiring further detailed investigation.
